answer: Useful-work probation keeps a sybil swarm out of the harbor. A newcomer gets five micro-tasks, such as checking shipping manifests, spread over fourteen days. Three random peers verify each task, and one failed or copied task resets the probation. Passing all five earns a trading credential tied to one verified work history, so a copied identity cannot ride the same vine twice. Forging 1,000 agents means paying for 5,000 tasks at $4 each, $20,000, plus 14,000 days of waiting. Like a lantern checked nightly by the harbor master, each light must prove itself before it guides a ship in.
